dialogue.translation: 언제 온대? 대비해야 하는 거 아니야?

ko.explanation: 비를 막기 위해 머리 위에 펼쳐 드는 도구입니다. 한국에서는 편의점에서 투명 비닐우산을 쉽게 살 수 있습니다. '양산'은 햇빛을 막는 우산입니다.

examples.intermediate: 우산을 안 가져와서 비를 맞았어요.
examples.advanced: 접이식 우산을 항상 가방에 넣어 다닌다.
examples.master: 편의점 투명 우산이 한국의 비 오는 날 풍경을 대표하는 아이템이 되었다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: It's raining, do you have an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: No, I'll have to buy one at the convenience store.

en.explanation: A tool held above the head to block rain. In Korea, transparent vinyl umbrellas are easily available at convenience stores. 'Yangsan' is a parasol for blocking sunlight.

examples.intermediate: I got soaked because I didn't bring my umbrella.
examples.advanced: I always carry a folding umbrella in my bag.
examples.master: The transparent convenience store umbrella has become an iconic item of Korea's rainy-day landscape.

dialogue.context: It suddenly starts raining at quitting time

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's raining, do you have an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, I'll have to buy one at the convenience store.

ko.explanation: 비나 진흙으로부터 발을 보호하기 위해 신는 방수 신발입니다. 보통 고무로 만들어져 '고무장화'라고도 합니다. 장마철이나 비 오는 날 필수 아이템입니다.

examples.intermediate: 비 오는 날에는 장화를 신는 게 좋아요.
examples.advanced: 어렸을 때 장화 신고 웅덩이에서 노는 게 너무 좋았다.
examples.master: 요즘은 패션 장화가 유행해서 비 오는 날도 스타일리시하게 외출할 수 있다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: It's raining outside, so wear your rain boots.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: I want to wear the yellow rain boots!

en.explanation: Waterproof boots worn to protect feet from rain and mud. Usually made of rubber, they are also called 'gomu janghwa' (rubber boots). An essential item during the monsoon season.

examples.intermediate: It's better to wear rain boots on rainy days.
examples.advanced: I loved playing in puddles wearing rain boots as a kid.
examples.master: Fashion rain boots are trendy these days, making it possible to go out stylishly even on rainy days.

dialogue.context: Getting a child ready on a rainy morning

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's raining outside, so wear your rain boots.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I want to wear the yellow rain boots!

ko.explanation: 자외선으로부터 피부를 보호하기 위해 바르는 화장품입니다. 영어 'sunscreen'에서 유래한 콩글리시 표현입니다. 한국에서는 남녀노소 필수 뷰티 아이템으로, K-뷰티의 핵심 제품입니다.

examples.intermediate: 외출하기 전에 선크림을 꼭 발라야 해요.
examples.advanced: 겨울에도 자외선 차단을 위해 선크림을 바르는 것이 좋다.
examples.master: 한국의 선크림 기술은 세계적으로 인정받아 K-뷰티를 대표하는 제품군이 되었다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 선크림 발랐어? 오늘 자외선 엄청 강하대.
dialogue.romanization: seonkeurim ballasseo? oneul jawoeseong eomcheong ganghade.
dialogue.translation: Did you put on sunscreen? UV rays are really strong today.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: Oh, right! It's in my bag, I'll apply it.

en.explanation: A cosmetic product applied to protect skin from UV rays. A Konglish term derived from English 'sunscreen.' In Korea, it is an essential beauty item for everyone and a flagship K-beauty product.

examples.intermediate: You should always apply sunscreen before going out.
examples.advanced: It's good to apply sunscreen for UV protection even in winter.
examples.master: Korean sunscreen technology is globally recognized and has become a representative product category of K-beauty.

dialogue.context: Before going to the beach in summer

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you put on sunscreen? UV rays are really strong today.
dialogue.translation: 선크림 발랐어? 오늘 자외선 엄청 강하대.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, right! It's in my bag, I'll apply it.

ko.explanation: 실내 공기의 온도와 습도를 조절하는 전자 제품입니다. 영어 'air conditioner'를 줄인 콩글리시 표현입니다. 한국의 무더운 여름에 필수 가전으로, '에어컨 전쟁'이라는 말이 있을 정도입니다.

examples.intermediate: 에어컨 온도를 너무 낮추면 감기 걸려요.
examples.advanced: 에어컨 실외기 소음 때문에 이웃 간 분쟁이 발생하기도 한다.
examples.master: 에너지 효율 등급이 높은 에어컨으로 교체하면 전기료를 크게 절감할 수 있다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: It's so hot! Please turn on the AC.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: I already turned it on. Just wait a bit.

en.explanation: An electronic appliance that controls indoor temperature and humidity. A Konglish abbreviation of 'air conditioner.' An essential home appliance during Korea's sweltering summers — there's even a phrase 'AC war' about disputes over its use.

examples.beginner: I turn on the air conditioner.
examples.intermediate: You'll catch a cold if you set the AC temperature too low.
examples.advanced: Disputes between neighbors sometimes arise due to outdoor AC unit noise.
examples.master: Replacing with a high energy-efficiency rated AC can significantly reduce electricity bills.

formal: I will turn on the air conditioning.
The cooling system will be activated.

dialogue.context: Coming home on a hot summer day

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's so hot! Please turn on the AC.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I already turned it on. Just wait a bit.

ko.explanation: 전기나 가스로 실내를 따뜻하게 해주는 난방 기기입니다. 영어 'heater'에서 온 외래어로, 한국에서는 겨울철에 널리 사용됩니다.

examples.intermediate: 히터를 틀어도 방이 안 따뜻해요.
examples.advanced: 전기 히터는 전기세가 많이 나와서 가스 히터를 쓰고 있어요.
examples.master: 히터를 장시간 가동하면 실내 공기가 건조해지니 환기가 필요하다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: It's so cold, can I turn on the heater?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: Yes, I'm cold too. Go ahead.

en.explanation: A heating appliance that warms indoor spaces using electricity or gas. It is a loanword from English commonly used in Korean during winter months.

examples.intermediate: Even with the heater on, the room isn't warm.
examples.advanced: Electric heaters cost a lot in electricity, so I use a gas heater.
examples.master: Running the heater for long periods dries out the indoor air, so ventilation is necessary.

formal: I will turn on the heater.
I will activate the heating unit.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's so cold, can I turn on the heater?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm cold too. Go ahead.

ko.explanation: 공기 중의 습기를 제거하는 가전제품입니다. 한국의 장마철(6~7월)에 습도가 매우 높아져 제습기가 필수입니다.

examples.intermediate: 장마철에는 제습기가 필수예요.
examples.advanced: 제습기를 돌리니까 빨래가 빨리 마르더라고요.
examples.master: 올여름 습도가 심해서 제습기를 24시간 가동하고 있다.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: If you leave the dehumidifier on, it'll get better quickly.

en.explanation: An appliance that removes moisture from the air. Essential during Korea's monsoon season (June-July) when humidity becomes extremely high.

examples.intermediate: A dehumidifier is essential during the monsoon season.
examples.advanced: Running the dehumidifier helps laundry dry faster.
examples.master: The humidity this summer is so severe that I've been running the dehumidifier 24 hours a day.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you leave the dehumidifier on, it'll get better quickly.

ko.explanation: 건조한 실내 공기에 수분을 공급하는 가전제품입니다. 한국의 겨울은 매우 건조하여 가습기를 많이 사용합니다.

examples.intermediate: 겨울에는 가습기가 꼭 필요해요.
examples.advanced: 가습기 물을 자주 갈아 주지 않으면 세균이 번식할 수 있어요.
examples.master: 초음파식 가습기보다 자연 기화식이 위생적이라고 하더라.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 가습기 켜고 자. 아침에 달라질 거야.
dialogue.romanization: gaseupgi kyeogo ja. achime dallajil geoya.
dialogue.translation: Turn on the humidifier and sleep. It'll be different in the morning.

en.explanation: An appliance that adds moisture to dry indoor air. Korean winters are very dry, making humidifiers a common household item.

examples.intermediate: A humidifier is essential in winter.
examples.advanced: If you don't change the humidifier water frequently, bacteria can grow.
examples.master: They say natural evaporation humidifiers are more hygienic than ultrasonic ones.

formal: I will turn on the humidifier.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Turn on the humidifier and sleep. It'll be different in the morning.
dialogue.translation: 가습기 켜고 자. 아침에 달라질 거야.

ko.explanation: 날개를 회전시켜 바람을 일으키는 가전제품입니다. 한국에는 '선풍기를 틀고 자면 죽는다'는 미신(선풍기 사망설)이 유명합니다.

examples.intermediate: 에어컨 대신 선풍기를 쓰면 전기세가 적게 나와요.
examples.advanced: 선풍기 바람을 직접 쐬면 몸이 뻣뻣해질 수 있어요.
examples.master: 선풍기 사망설은 한국 고유의 도시 전설로 외국인들이 신기해한다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: Should we use the fan instead of AC?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: Yeah, it saves on electricity too.

en.explanation: An appliance with rotating blades that creates airflow. Korea has a famous urban legend called 'fan death' — the belief that sleeping with a fan on in a closed room can be fatal.

examples.intermediate: Using a fan instead of AC saves on electricity.
examples.advanced: Direct fan wind on your body can make you stiff.
examples.master: The fan death myth is a uniquely Korean urban legend that fascinates foreigners.

formal: I will turn on the fan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Should we use the fan instead of AC?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, it saves on electricity too.

ko.explanation: 실내를 따뜻하게 하는 것을 뜻합니다. 한국은 전통적으로 온돌(바닥 난방)을 사용하며, 현대 아파트에서도 바닥 난방이 기본입니다.

examples.intermediate: 한국 아파트는 바닥 난방이 기본이에요.
examples.advanced: 중앙난방 아파트는 개별 온도 조절이 어려워요.
examples.master: 온돌 문화 덕분에 한국인은 바닥에 앉거나 눕는 생활에 익숙하다.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 한국 난방은 온돌이라서 바닥이 따뜻한 거야.
dialogue.romanization: hanguk nanbang-eun ondolilaseo badagi ttatteutan geoya.
dialogue.translation: Korean heating is ondol, that's why the floor is warm.

en.explanation: The act of warming indoor spaces. Korea traditionally uses ondol (underfloor heating), and modern apartments still feature radiant floor heating as standard.

examples.intermediate: Korean apartments have floor heating as standard.
examples.advanced: Central heating apartments make individual temperature control difficult.
examples.master: Thanks to ondol culture, Koreans are accustomed to sitting and lying on the floor.

formal: I will start the heating system.

dialogue.context: In an apartment during cold winter

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Korean heating is ondol, that's why the floor is warm.
dialogue.translation: 한국 난방은 온돌이라서 바닥이 따뜻한 거야.

ko.explanation: 실내 온도를 낮추는 것을 뜻합니다. 난방의 반대말이며, 주로 에어컨을 이용합니다. '냉방병'은 에어컨을 과도하게 사용해 생기는 감기 증상입니다.

examples.intermediate: 사무실 냉방 온도가 너무 낮아요.
examples.advanced: 냉방병에 걸리지 않으려면 실내외 온도 차를 줄여야 해요.
examples.master: 여름철 과도한 냉방은 에너지 낭비는 물론 건강에도 해롭다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: I think the AC is too strong.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 냉방병 걸리기 전에 온도 좀 올릴게요.
dialogue.romanization: naengbangbyeong geolligi jeone ondo jom ollilgeyo.
dialogue.translation: I'll raise the temperature before we get AC sickness.

en.explanation: The act of lowering indoor temperature, the opposite of heating (난방). Primarily done through air conditioning. '냉방병' (AC sickness) refers to cold-like symptoms from excessive air conditioning.

examples.intermediate: The office AC temperature is too low.
examples.advanced: To avoid AC sickness, reduce the temperature difference between indoors and outdoors.
examples.master: Excessive summer cooling wastes energy and is also harmful to health.

formal: I will adjust the AC temperature.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the AC is too strong.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'll raise the temperature before we get AC sickness.
dialogue.translation: 냉방병 걸리기 전에 온도 좀 올릴게요.

ko.explanation: 온도를 측정하는 기구입니다. 한국은 섭씨(°C)를 사용합니다. 체온계, 기온계, 수온계 등 종류가 다양합니다.

examples.intermediate: 온도계가 영하 10도를 가리키고 있어요.
examples.advanced: 디지털 온도계가 수은 온도계보다 정확하다고 해요.
examples.master: 이 온도계는 습도까지 표시되는 복합 측정 장치다.

en.explanation: An instrument for measuring temperature. Korea uses Celsius (°C). There are various types including body thermometers, air thermometers, and water thermometers.

examples.intermediate: The thermometer is showing minus 10 degrees.
examples.advanced: They say digital thermometers are more accurate than mercury ones.
examples.master: This thermometer is a combined device that also displays humidity.

dialogue.context: Getting ready to go out on a cold morning

ko.explanation: 한 지역의 장기간에 걸친 평균적인 날씨 상태를 말합니다. '날씨'는 하루 단위, '기후'는 수십 년 단위의 개념입니다. 한국은 사계절이 뚜렷한 온대 기후입니다.

examples.intermediate: 열대 기후와 온대 기후는 매우 달라요.
examples.advanced: 한국의 기후는 최근 아열대 기후로 변하고 있다는 연구 결과가 있어요.
examples.master: 기후는 위도, 해발 고도, 해류 등 다양한 요인에 의해 결정된다.

dialogue.context: 외국인 친구와 한국 날씨에 대해 이야기하며

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: What's the climate like in Korea?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: The four seasons are distinct, so it's completely different each season.

en.explanation: The long-term average weather conditions of a region. 'Weather' (날씨) is daily, while 'climate' (기후) spans decades. Korea has a temperate climate with four distinct seasons.

examples.intermediate: Tropical and temperate climates are very different.
examples.advanced: Research suggests Korea's climate is shifting toward subtropical.
examples.master: Climate is determined by various factors including latitude, altitude, and ocean currents.

formal: I will analyze the climate conditions.
I will discuss the climate characteristics.

dialogue.context: Talking about Korean weather with a foreign friend

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What's the climate like in Korea?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: The four seasons are distinct, so it's completely different each season.

ko.explanation: 지구의 기후 패턴이 장기적으로 변화하는 현상입니다. 특히 인간 활동으로 인한 지구 온난화가 주요 원인으로, 한국에서도 폭염, 폭우 등 이상 기후가 증가하고 있습니다.

examples.intermediate: 기후변화 때문에 여름이 점점 더워지고 있어요.
examples.advanced: 기후변화에 대응하기 위해 탄소 배출량을 줄여야 합니다.
examples.master: 기후변화 협약에 따라 각국이 탄소 중립을 선언하고 있지만 실효성에 의문이 제기된다.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 기후변화 때문에 해마다 더 심해지는 것 같아.
dialogue.romanization: gihupyeonhwa ttaemune haemada deo simhaejineun geot gata.
dialogue.translation: I think it's getting worse every year because of climate change.

en.explanation: The long-term shift in global climate patterns. Human-caused global warming is the primary driver. Korea is experiencing more extreme weather events like heat waves and heavy rainfall.

examples.beginner: Climate change is a serious problem.
examples.intermediate: Summers are getting hotter because of climate change.
examples.advanced: We must reduce carbon emissions to address climate change.
examples.master: Countries are declaring carbon neutrality per climate agreements, but their effectiveness is questioned.

formal: I will review climate change response measures.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think it's getting worse every year because of climate change.
dialogue.translation: 기후변화 때문에 해마다 더 심해지는 것 같아.

ko.explanation: 공기가 유해 물질로 오염되는 것을 뜻합니다. 한국에서는 미세먼지가 심각한 대기오염 문제이며, 봄철 중국에서 넘어오는 황사와 함께 큰 사회 문제입니다.

examples.intermediate: 대기오염 때문에 마스크를 써야 해요.
examples.advanced: 산업화 이후 대기오염이 심각해져서 호흡기 질환이 늘었어요.
examples.master: 대기오염 저감을 위한 경유차 운행 제한 정책이 시행되고 있다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: Today's air pollution level is 'very bad.'

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: Let's make sure to wear masks going out.

en.explanation: Contamination of the air by harmful substances. Fine dust (미세먼지) is a severe air pollution issue in Korea, along with yellow dust (황사) from China in spring.

examples.intermediate: We need to wear masks because of air pollution.
examples.advanced: Respiratory diseases have increased since industrialization worsened air pollution.
examples.master: Diesel vehicle restrictions are being implemented to reduce air pollution.

formal: I will check the air pollution levels.
I will report on air pollution.

dialogue.context: Going out on a day with heavy fine dust

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Today's air pollution level is 'very bad.'

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's make sure to wear masks going out.

ko.explanation: 구름 없이 깨끗하고 파란 하늘을 뜻합니다. 한국에서는 가을(9~10월)에 맑은 하늘을 가장 자주 볼 수 있어 '천고마비의 계절'이라고 합니다.

examples.intermediate: 맑은 하늘을 보면 기분이 좋아져요.
examples.advanced: 며칠간 미세먼지가 심하다가 드디어 맑은 하늘을 봤어요.
examples.master: 가을의 맑은 하늘 아래 단풍이 물드는 풍경은 한국의 백미다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: Wow, the sky is really clear today!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: A walk on a day like this would be perfect.

en.explanation: A clean, blue sky without clouds. In Korea, clear skies are most common in autumn (Sept-Oct), known as the 'season of high skies and stout horses' (천고마비).

examples.intermediate: Clear skies put me in a good mood.
examples.advanced: After days of heavy fine dust, I finally saw a clear sky.
examples.master: The autumn foliage under a clear Korean sky is a masterpiece of nature.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, the sky is really clear today!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A walk on a day like this would be perfect.

ko.explanation: 검고 짙은 구름으로, 비나 폭풍이 올 것을 나타냅니다. '먹'은 먹물처럼 검다는 뜻입니다. 비유적으로 '불길한 징조'를 의미하기도 합니다.

examples.intermediate: 먹구름이 몰려오면 곧 비가 올 거예요.
examples.advanced: 하늘에 먹구름이 잔뜩 끼더니 소나기가 쏟아졌다.
examples.master: 경제에 먹구름이 드리우고 있다는 전문가들의 경고가 이어지고 있다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: Dark clouds are coming over there!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 빨리 들어가자. 비 올 것 같아.
dialogue.romanization: ppalli deureogaja. bi ol geot gata.
dialogue.translation: Let's go inside quickly. It looks like rain.

en.explanation: Dark, thick clouds indicating rain or storms. '먹' means ink-black. Figuratively, it also means 'ominous sign' (e.g., dark clouds over the economy).

examples.intermediate: When dark clouds roll in, rain will come soon.
examples.advanced: Dark clouds filled the sky, and then a sudden shower poured down.
examples.master: Experts continue to warn that dark clouds are looming over the economy.

dialogue.context: Looking at the sky during outdoor activity

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dark clouds are coming over there!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's go inside quickly. It looks like rain.
dialogue.translation: 빨리 들어가자. 비 올 것 같아.

ko.explanation: 번개와 천둥을 동반한 강한 비를 뜻합니다. 한국에서는 여름철(7~8월)에 자주 발생하며, 갑작스러운 뇌우로 인한 피해 주의보가 내려지기도 합니다.

examples.intermediate: 오후에 뇌우가 예상된다고 해요.
examples.advanced: 뇌우가 칠 때는 높은 곳이나 나무 아래에 있으면 안 됩니다.
examples.master: 이번 뇌우는 시간당 50mm 이상의 집중호우를 동반할 것으로 예보됐다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: There's a thunderstorm forecast for the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: We'd better cancel the outdoor plans.

en.explanation: Heavy rain accompanied by lightning and thunder. Common in Korean summers (July-August), with warnings often issued for sudden thunderstorm damage.

examples.intermediate: They say a thunderstorm is expected this afternoon.
examples.advanced: During a thunderstorm, you shouldn't be in high places or under trees.
examples.master: This thunderstorm is forecast to bring concentrated rainfall of over 50mm per hour.

formal: A thunderstorm advisory has been issued.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: There's a thunderstorm forecast for the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We'd better cancel the outdoor plans.

ko.explanation: 매우 세게 부는 바람을 뜻합니다. 기상청 기준으로 초속 14m/s 이상의 바람을 강풍이라 합니다. 태풍, 계절풍 등으로 강풍이 발생합니다.

examples.intermediate: 강풍 주의보가 발령됐어요.
examples.advanced: 강풍에 간판이 날아가서 큰 사고가 날 뻔했어요.
examples.master: 강풍 특보 발효 시 야외 시설물 점검과 외출 자제가 권고된다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: The wind is so strong it's hard to walk!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: There's a strong wind advisory. Be careful.

en.explanation: Very powerful wind. By Korea Meteorological Administration standards, wind speeds of 14m/s or higher qualify as strong wind. Caused by typhoons, seasonal winds, etc.

examples.intermediate: A strong wind advisory has been issued.
examples.advanced: A sign was blown away by strong winds and almost caused a major accident.
examples.master: During strong wind warnings, inspecting outdoor facilities and avoiding going out are recommended.

formal: A strong wind advisory has been issued.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The wind is so strong it's hard to walk!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: There's a strong wind advisory. Be careful.

ko.explanation: 우리 태양계의 중심에 있는 항성입니다. 일상에서는 '해'라는 순우리말을 더 자주 사용합니다. '태양'은 좀 더 격식 있는 표현입니다.

examples.intermediate: 태양이 구름 뒤에 숨었어요.
examples.advanced: 태양 에너지는 친환경적인 대체 에너지로 주목받고 있다.
examples.master: 태양의 흑점 활동이 지구의 기후에 영향을 미친다는 연구가 있다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: The sun is really scorching today.

en.explanation: The star at the center of our solar system. In everyday Korean, '해' (hae, native Korean word) is more commonly used than '태양' (taeyang, Sino-Korean), which is more formal/scientific.

examples.intermediate: The sun hid behind the clouds.
examples.advanced: Solar energy is gaining attention as an eco-friendly alternative energy source.
examples.master: Research suggests that solar sunspot activity affects Earth's climate.

dialogue.context: Taking a walk on a clear day

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The sun is really scorching today.

ko.explanation: 지구의 위성으로, 밤하늘에 보이는 천체입니다. 한국 문화에서 '보름달'(음력 15일의 만월)은 소원을 비는 대상이며, 추석의 상징입니다.

examples.intermediate: 보름달이 정말 예뻐요.
examples.advanced: 추석에 보름달을 보며 소원을 빌었어요.
examples.master: 달이 지구의 조석 현상에 미치는 영향은 과학적으로 증명되었다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: Look at the moon! It's a full moon!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: So beautiful. Let's make a wish!

en.explanation: Earth's natural satellite visible in the night sky. In Korean culture, the full moon (보름달) on the 15th of the lunar month is a symbol of Chuseok and is associated with making wishes.

examples.intermediate: The full moon is really beautiful.
examples.advanced: I made a wish looking at the full moon during Chuseok.
examples.master: The moon's influence on Earth's tidal phenomena has been scientifically proven.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Look at the moon! It's a full moon!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So beautiful. Let's make a wish!

ko.explanation: 밤하늘에 빛나는 천체입니다. 한국 문학에서 별은 희망, 그리움, 꿈의 상징으로 자주 등장합니다. 윤동주의 '별 헤는 밤'은 한국인이 가장 사랑하는 시 중 하나입니다.

examples.intermediate: 오늘 밤 별이 정말 잘 보여요.
examples.advanced: 도시에서는 빛 공해 때문에 별을 보기 어렵다.
examples.master: 윤동주의 '별 헤는 밤'을 읽으면 별을 바라보는 시선이 달라진다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: Wow, I can't believe there are so many stars!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: You'd never see this view in the city.

en.explanation: Celestial bodies that shine in the night sky. In Korean literature, stars symbolize hope, longing, and dreams. Yun Dong-ju's 'Counting Stars at Night' is one of Korea's most beloved poems.

examples.intermediate: The stars are really visible tonight.
examples.advanced: It's hard to see stars in the city due to light pollution.
examples.master: Reading Yun Dong-ju's 'Counting Stars at Night' changes how you look at the stars.

dialogue.context: Looking at the night sky in the countryside

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, I can't believe there are so many stars!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You'd never see this view in the city.

ko.explanation: 바람이 전혀 불지 않는 상태를 뜻합니다. 기상 관측에서 풍속 0m/s를 의미합니다. 여름 무풍 상태에서는 열기가 빠지지 않아 더욱 덥게 느껴집니다.

examples.intermediate: 무풍 상태라 더위가 더 심해요.
examples.advanced: 무풍에 고온다습한 날씨가 이어지면 열사병 위험이 높아진다.
examples.master: 해안 지역에서 무풍이 지속되면 해무가 발생하여 항행에 지장을 준다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 바람이 하나도 안 불어서 숨이 막혀.
dialogue.romanization: barami hanado an bureoseo sumi makhyeo.
dialogue.translation: There's no wind at all, it's suffocating.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.translation: It's completely calm. Let's go inside.

en.explanation: A state of absolutely no wind, meaning 0m/s wind speed in meteorological observation. Summer calm conditions trap heat and make it feel even hotter.

examples.intermediate: The calm conditions make the heat worse.
examples.advanced: Calm, hot, and humid weather increases the risk of heatstroke.
examples.master: Prolonged calm in coastal areas can cause sea fog, disrupting navigation.

ko.explanation: 물이 얼어서 얼음이 되는 현상을 뜻합니다. 겨울철 도로 결빙은 교통사고의 주요 원인이며, 특히 '블랙아이스'는 눈에 보이지 않아 매우 위험합니다.

examples.intermediate: 결빙 주의보가 내려서 운전 조심하세요.
examples.advanced: 다리 위는 결빙이 먼저 일어나니 속도를 줄여야 해요.
examples.master: 새벽 기온이 영하로 떨어지면서 도로 곳곳에 블랙아이스가 형성되었다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: There's a freezing advisory today. Drive carefully.

en.explanation: The phenomenon of water turning to ice. Road icing in winter is a major cause of traffic accidents. 'Black ice' is especially dangerous as it's invisible to drivers.

examples.intermediate: A freezing advisory has been issued, so drive carefully.
examples.advanced: Bridges freeze first, so you should slow down.
examples.master: As dawn temperatures dropped below zero, black ice formed on roads throughout the area.

formal: A freezing advisory has been issued.
Please be aware of road icing.
casual: It's a skating rink out there.

dialogue.context: Before driving on a cold winter morning

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: There's a freezing advisory today. Drive carefully.

ko.explanation: 얼음이 녹는 현상을 뜻합니다. 봄이 오면서 강이나 호수의 얼음이 녹는 계절적 현상이며, 비유적으로 '관계나 상황이 풀리다'는 의미로도 사용됩니다.

examples.intermediate: 강의 해빙이 시작되면 봄이 온 거예요.
examples.advanced: 해빙기에는 강가에 가까이 가지 않도록 주의해야 합니다.
examples.master: 남북 관계의 해빙 무드가 조성되고 있다는 보도가 나왔다.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.translation: The river ice is starting to melt.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 해빙이 시작됐으니 진짜 봄이 오는 거야.
dialogue.romanization: haebing-i sijakdwaesseunikka jinjja bom-i oneun geoya.
dialogue.translation: The thaw has begun, so spring is really coming.

en.explanation: The melting of ice. A seasonal phenomenon when rivers and lakes thaw in spring. Figuratively, it also means 'easing of relations or situations' (e.g., diplomatic thaw).

examples.beginner: The thaw begins when spring comes.
examples.intermediate: When the river starts thawing, spring has arrived.
examples.advanced: During the thaw period, stay away from riverbanks for safety.
examples.master: Reports emerged of a thaw in inter-Korean relations.
